papers.title: Can Language Models Play the Wikipedia Game?
papers.translated_title: 语言模型能玩维基百科游戏吗？
papers.author: Alexander Hickey
papers.summary: Language models increasingly support or automate information retrieval from document collections too large to index. This task is difficult when it requires specialist linguistic or scientific knowledge. We used the Wikipedia Game to test language models on an analogous information retrieval task. In the game, players must reach a target article using only article links. We compared sentence embedding models and LLMs across five Wikipedia languages and five academic-literature datasets. We construct very large local graphs of Wikipedia pages and of paper citations using OpenAlex and provide code to build and navigate them. This allows the study of language models' navigation capabilities without relying on third-party APIs. We compared the models with human and TF-IDF benchmarks. The Wikipedia Game format enables robust comparisons across techniques, languages, and domains. No model significantly outperformed humans, although the best models (GPT-o3 mini, GPT-4o, QwQ:32B, and DeepSeek-R1:70B) achieved comparable success. Performance and rankings varied across languages and topics, with implications for practitioners utilising these techniques.
papers.translated_summary: 语言模型越来越多地支持或自动化从大到无法索引的文档集合中进行信息检索。当这项任务需要专业语言学或科学知识时，它就变得困难。我们使用维基百科游戏来测试语言模型在一项类似的信息检索任务上的表现。在游戏中，玩家必须仅使用文章链接到达目标文章。我们在五种维基百科语言和五个学术文献数据集上比较了句子嵌入模型和大型语言模型。我们使用 OpenAlex 构建了维基百科页面和论文引用的超大型局部图，并提供代码来构建和导航它们。这使得研究语言模型的导航能力无需依赖第三方 API。我们将这些模型与人类和 TF-IDF 基准进行了比较。维基百科游戏形式使得跨技术、语言和领域的稳健比较成为可能。没有模型显著优于人类，尽管最佳模型（GPT-o3 mini、GPT-4o、QwQ:32B 和 DeepSeek-R1:70B）取得了相当的成功。性能和排名因语言和主题而异，这对利用这些技术的从业者具有启示意义。

papers.title: Towards Physically Grounded Articulated 3D Assets: A Multi-Agent Pipeline and Benchmark
papers.translated_title: 面向物理落地的铰接式3D资产：多智能体流水线与基准
papers.author: Xudong Cai
papers.summary: In this paper, we study physically grounded articulated 3D asset generation---moving the goal from reproducing how objects look to capturing how they move and function. Inspired by the literature on procedural and agentic generation, we present Artisan, a system that extends the latest method Articraft by introducing a multi-agent pipeline with physical simulation feedback, enabling comprehensive attributes beyond geometry, appearance, and physically plausible articulation, such as collision-free motion, stability under gravity, and accurate mass and material properties. Furthermore, we construct a unified benchmark spanning four key aspects: spatial fidelity, physical plausibility, downstream task performance, and overall quality. The benchmark encompasses 100 reference assets from ArtVIP and LightWheel, 50 stability prompts, and 50 ABO objects with reference masses, with protocols evaluating various metrics. Through extensive evaluation of more than 10 representative models, Artisan achieves competitive spatial fidelity while attaining the lowest collision rates and highest stability rates among the evaluated methods. Together, our system and benchmark establish insights for advancing 3D generation towards physically plausible, functionally usable assets.
papers.translated_summary: 在本文中，我们研究基于物理的铰接式3D资产生成——将目标从复现物体的外观转向捕捉其如何运动和运作。受程序化生成和智能体生成文献的启发，我们提出了Artisan，一个扩展了最新方法Articraft的系统，通过引入带有物理仿真反馈的多智能体流水线，实现了超越几何、外观和物理合理铰接的全面属性，例如无碰撞运动、重力下的稳定性以及准确的质量和材料属性。此外，我们构建了一个涵盖四个关键方面的统一基准：空间保真度、物理合理性、下游任务性能和整体质量。该基准包含来自ArtVIP和LightWheel的100个参考资产、50个稳定性提示，以及50个带有参考质量的ABO物体，并采用评估各种指标的协议。通过对超过10个代表性模型进行广泛评估，Artisan在实现具有竞争力的空间保真度的同时，在所评估的方法中达到了最低的碰撞率和最高的稳定性率。我们的系统和基准共同为推进3D生成走向物理合理、功能可用的资产提供了洞见。

papers.title: Splat2Act: From Captured Scenes to Personalized VLA Manipulation
papers.translated_title: Splat2Act：从捕获场景到个性化VLA操作
papers.author: Xiaomeng Ye
papers.summary: A user who brings a generalist manipulation policy into their home or office wants it to pick up their objects from their shelves, counters, and tables. Yet even a strong generalist like $π_{0.5}$ achieves 0% pickup success in our captured deployment scenes without adaptation, and collecting real demonstrations in every user's environment is prohibitively expensive. We present Splat2Act, an automated real-to-sim-to-real pipeline that personalizes a pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policy to a specific scene and object set using only a handheld phone scan and images of the user's objects. Unlike prior real-to-sim work that reconstructs individual tabletops, Splat2Act operates on building-scale indoor environments: it builds a photorealistic digital twin with 3D Gaussian Splatting and collision geometry, automatically discovers tabletop and non-tabletop receptacles, constructs feasible pickup tasks, and generates successful demonstrations with a privileged simulation oracle, with only scene and object capture required from a human. Applied to 101 scanned campus environments with a median navigable area of 104.87 m$^2$ and 7 receptacles, the pipeline yields 852 receptacles and over 68,000 pickup demonstrations. We fine-tune $π_{0.5}$ in two stages: Stage 1 adapts to hundreds of public object assets, drawn either from the deployment scene alone or from all 101 scenes; Stage 2 personalizes to the user's own objects on the deployment scene's receptacles. Our strongest personalized policy reaches 62.5% aggregate pickup success in the target scene. Deployed on a real Stretch 3, the same policy achieves 63.9% success on a 12-task subset, closely tracking its 66.7% simulated success on those tasks. These results suggest that automated real-to-sim-to-real training can personalize VLA manipulation policies using only simulation-oracle data.
papers.translated_summary: 将通用操作策略带入家庭或办公室的用户希望它能从架子、柜台和桌面上拾取物品。然而，即使是像 $π_{0.5}$ 这样强大的通用策略，在我们捕获的部署场景中未经适配也达到 0% 的拾取成功率，而在每个用户环境中收集真实演示的成本高得令人望而却步。我们提出 Splat2Act，一种自动化的真实到仿真再到真实的流水线，仅使用手持手机扫描和用户物体的图像，就能将预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略个性化到特定场景和物体集。与先前重建单个桌面的真实到仿真工作不同，Splat2Act 在建筑尺度的室内环境中运行：它使用 3D 高斯泼溅和碰撞几何构建逼真的数字孪生，自动发现桌面和非桌面容器，构建可行的拾取任务，并使用特权仿真预言机生成成功演示，人类只需提供场景和物体捕获。应用于 101 个扫描的校园环境（中位可导航面积为 104.87 m$^2$，7 个容器），该流水线产生 852 个容器和超过 68,000 个拾取演示。我们分两个阶段微调 $π_{0.5}$：阶段 1 适配数百个公共物体资产，这些资产要么仅来自部署场景，要么来自全部 101 个场景；阶段 2 在部署场景的容器上个性化到用户自己的物体。我们最强的个性化策略在目标场景中达到 62.5% 的总拾取成功率。部署在真实的 Stretch 3 上，同一策略在 12 个任务的子集上达到 63.9% 的成功率，与其在这些任务上 66.7% 的仿真成功率密切吻合。这些结果表明，自动化的真实到仿真再到真实训练可以仅使用仿真预言机数据来个性化 VLA 操作策略。

papers.title: InstantFusion: A Shared Latent Interface for Heterogeneous Image Generators
papers.translated_title: InstantFusion：异构图像生成器的共享潜在接口
papers.author: Xuanlang Dai
papers.summary: Diffusion/flow models have emerged as the de facto paradigms for image generation, giving rise to a diverse family of modern generators with increasingly heterogeneous architectures and representations. Despite their remarkable generation capabilities, the cross-model alignment of latent representations and the consistency of their underlying denoising dynamics remain underexplored. In this work, we uncover an intriguing cross-model compatibility: independently trained generators exhibit similar latent spatial organization, while directly handing off intermediate states between unaligned models can still preserve coarse visual content. Motivated by these observations, we propose InstantFusion, a lightweight shared latent interface that connects the denoising trajectories of heterogeneous image generators. Specifically, to enable flexible cross-model state translation, model-specific Latent AutoEncoders (LAEs) are introduced to project intermediate states from different generators into a shared latent space and decode them into the latent space of a target generator. This shared space is constrained by two complementary objectives: aligning intermediate states derived from the same image at matched noise levels and synchronizing their corresponding local denoising velocities. Once trained, InstantFusion allows denoising to seamlessly transition across frozen generators without requiring a dedicated mapping for every model pair. The versatility of InstantFusion is demonstrated across acceleration, multi-preference composition, cross-architecture on-policy distillation, and cross-model composition, achieving competitive performance across these diverse settings.
papers.translated_summary: 扩散/流模型已成为图像生成的事实上的范式，催生了多样化的现代生成器家族，其架构和表示日益异构。尽管这些模型具有卓越的生成能力，但潜在表示的跨模型对齐及其底层去噪动态的一致性仍未得到充分探索。在这项工作中，我们揭示了一个有趣的跨模型兼容性：独立训练的生成器表现出相似的潜在空间组织，而直接在未对齐模型之间传递中间状态仍能保留粗略的视觉内容。受这些观察的启发，我们提出了 InstantFusion，一种轻量级共享潜在接口，用于连接异构图像生成器的去噪轨迹。具体而言，为了实现灵活的跨模型状态转换，引入了模型特定的潜在自编码器（LAEs），将来自不同生成器的中间状态投影到共享潜在空间，并将其解码到目标生成器的潜在空间中。该共享空间受两个互补目标的约束：在匹配噪声水平下对齐来自同一图像的中间状态，并同步其对应的局部去噪速度。训练完成后，InstantFusion 允许去噪在冻结的生成器之间无缝转换，而无需为每一对模型专门映射。InstantFusion 的多功能性在加速、多偏好组合、跨架构在线策略蒸馏和跨模型组合中得到了展示，在这些多样化设置中均取得了有竞争力的性能。

papers.title: Images Talk Back: Guiding MMDiTs by Suppressing Image-to-Text Feedback
papers.translated_title: 图像反击：通过抑制图像到文本反馈来引导MMDiT
papers.author: Yucheng Yang
papers.summary: Multimodal diffusion transformers (MMDiTs) allow the evolving image to update internal text representations through joint attention. These representations then guide subsequent image updates, raising a question: does this feedback help correct deviations from the prompt, or preserve them? We find that image-to-text (I2T) feedback can preserve the objects and attributes already represented in the evolving image, including errors. Transplanting I2T messages can rescue failures or disrupt successes. At matched intervention strengths, suppressing the influence of I2T feedback improves generation, whereas opposite controls degrade it. These findings motivate Semantic Feedback Guidance (SFG), which suppresses the influence of I2T feedback by guiding away from an auxiliary branch that strengthens this feedback and weakens text-to-image conditioning. The in-place variant, iSFG, directly suppresses I2T feedback and strengthens text-to-image conditioning, requiring no extra model evaluations. Temporal interventions motivate running the SFG branch during the first 20% of image sampling steps, requiring about $1.2\times$ the base NFE without classifier-free guidance (CFG). Experiments across three image-generation backbones show gains in alignment and preference-model scores. On FLUX, adding SFG to CFG raises GenEval from $0.6661$ to $0.7479$; on SD3.5M, iSFG adds $+1.33$ HPSv2.1 over CFG at zero extra NFE. The control also transfers to text-to-video and image-to-video generation, improving VBench scores. Code is available at https://github.com/yyc1215lll-creator/SFG.
papers.translated_summary: 多模态扩散变换器（MMDiTs）通过联合注意力机制，使演化中的图像能够更新内部文本表示。这些表示随后引导后续的图像更新，由此引出一个问题：这种反馈是有助于纠正与提示词的偏差，还是会保留这些偏差？我们发现，图像到文本（I2T）反馈能够保留演化图像中已经表示的物体和属性，包括错误。移植 I2T 信息可以挽救失败或破坏成功。在匹配的干预强度下，抑制 I2T 反馈的影响能够改善生成，而相反的控制则会使其退化。这些发现促成了语义反馈引导（SFG），它通过引导远离一个增强该反馈并削弱文本到图像条件的辅助分支，来抑制 I2T 反馈的影响。其原地变体 iSFG 直接抑制 I2T 反馈并增强文本到图像条件，无需额外的模型评估。时间干预促使在图像采样步骤的前 20% 运行 SFG 分支，在无分类器引导（CFG）的情况下需要约 $1.2\times$ 的基础 NFE。在三个图像生成骨干网络上的实验显示，在对齐度和偏好模型分数上均有提升。在 FLUX 上，将 SFG 添加到 CFG 使 GenEval 从 $0.6661$ 提升至 $0.7479$；在 SD3.5M 上，iSFG 在零额外 NFE 的情况下比 CFG 增加了 $+1.33$ HPSv2.1。该控制方法还可迁移到文本到视频和图像到视频生成，提升 VBench 分数。代码可在 https://github.com/yyc1215lll-creator/SFG 获取。

papers.title: Hide and Seek: HIDE Concepts to SEEK explanations for black box models
papers.translated_title: 捉迷藏：用HIDE概念为黑箱模型寻找解释
papers.author: Bhanu Tokas
papers.summary: Interpreting machine learning model predictions is a central challenge, particularly for black-box vision models. Concept-based attribution methods interpret models using human-understandable concepts. Existing concept-based methods can only interpret classification and regression models. They require access to model weights or large concept-annotated datasets, and most methods cannot provide image-level attribution. We propose Hide and Seek (HnS), a new method for concept-level attribution that does not require access to model weights or labeled concept datasets. HnS can interpret a wide range of vision models. Given a concept and image set, HnS retrieves concept-aligned images using a vision-language model, localizes the concept within each image, masks the localized region, and measures attribution from the change in the black-box model's output between the original and masked images. This enables faithful attribution by directly measuring the model's behavior and supporting local attributions. We validated HnS on CelebA and COCO-Stuff. Compared to existing methods, HnS showed better agreement with ground-truth attributions. We demonstrated the applicability of HnS on diverse tasks, including image captioning and satellite image segmentation, where no existing concept attribution method can be used. We provided our anonymous code in the supplementary material.
papers.translated_summary: 解读机器学习模型的预测是一项核心挑战，尤其是对于黑盒视觉模型。基于概念的解释方法使用人类可理解的概念来解释模型。现有的基于概念的方法只能解释分类和回归模型。它们需要访问模型权重或大规模概念标注数据集，而且大多数方法无法提供图像级归因。我们提出了 Hide and Seek（HnS），一种新的概念级归因方法，不需要访问模型权重或标注概念数据集。HnS 可以解释多种视觉模型。给定一个概念和图像集，HnS 使用视觉语言模型检索与概念对齐的图像，在每个图像中定位该概念，遮蔽定位区域，并通过测量原始图像与遮蔽图像之间黑盒模型输出的变化来度量归因。这通过直接测量模型行为并支持局部归因，实现了忠实的归因。我们在 CelebA 和 COCO-Stuff 上验证了 HnS。与现有方法相比，HnS 与真实归因表现出更好的一致性。我们展示了 HnS 在多种任务上的适用性，包括图像描述和卫星图像分割，在这些任务中现有概念归因方法均无法使用。我们在补充材料中提供了匿名代码。

papers.title: Constructive Bounds for the Topological Expressivity of Neural Networks
papers.translated_title: 神经网络拓扑表达力的构造性边界
papers.author: Kosio Beshkov
papers.summary: The expressivity of a neural network $Φ$ describes the class of functions that a network can express. The term topological expressivity refers to a family of measures particularly suited to understand binary classification and is often formulated in terms of the Betti numbers of a decision boundary $β(Φ^{-1}(0))$. Despite its popularity, this measure is not as useful for regression and other problems that do not involve a decision boundary. Instead, we propose to study topological expressivity in terms of the Betti numbers of the output of a neural network $β(Φ(X))$. We formally prove that a ReLU network with architecture $(d,\sum\limits_{k=1}^{d } β_k(3k+2),\sum\limits_{k=1}^{d}β_k(k+1))$ can express spaces homotopy equivalent to wedge sums of spheres with arbitrary Betti numbers. This gives upper bounds for any arbitrary connected ($β_0=1$) sequence of Betti numbers, but by constructing spaces homotopy equivalent to products of $N$ spheres of dimension $d_1,...,d_N$ we achieve much better bounds $(\sum\limits_{n=1} d_n, 3\sum\limits_{n=1}\limits^N d_n + 2N, \sum\limits_{n=1}\limits^N d_n + N) $ for Betti numbers given by $\prod_n (1+x^{d_n})$. Finally we conjecture a much stronger tight bound which gives the architectural bound $(d,d+1,d+1)$ for a space homeomorphic to the sphere.
papers.translated_summary: 神经网络 \(\Phi\) 的表达能力描述了网络能够表达的函数类。拓扑表达能力这一术语指的是一类特别适合理解二分类问题的度量，通常用决策边界 \(\beta(\Phi^{-1}(0))\) 的 Betti 数来表述。尽管这一度量很受欢迎，但它对于回归以及其他不涉及决策边界的问题并不那么有用。相反，我们提出从神经网络输出 \(\beta(\Phi(X))\) 的 Betti 数来研究拓扑表达能力。我们正式证明，一个具有架构 \((d,\sum\limits_{k=1}^{d } \beta_k(3k+2),\sum\limits_{k=1}^{d}\beta_k(k+1))\) 的 ReLU 网络可以表达与具有任意 Betti 数的球面楔和同伦等价的空间。这给出了任意连通（\(\beta_0=1\)）Betti 数序列的上界，但通过构造与 \(N\) 个维度为 \(d_1,...,d_N\) 的球面的乘积同伦等价的空间，我们对于由 \(\prod_n (1+x^{d_n})\) 给出的 Betti 数实现了更好的界 \((\sum\limits_{n=1} d_n, 3\sum\limits_{n=1}\limits^N d_n + 2N, \sum\limits_{n=1}\limits^N d_n + N) \)。最后，我们猜想一个更强得多的紧界，它对于与球面同胚的空间给出架构界 \((d,d+1,d+1)\)。

papers.title: Chronos Policy: Learning Robot Policies on Physical Time
papers.translated_title: Chronos策略：在物理时间上学习机器人策略
papers.author: Changhao Wang
papers.summary: Robot policies often convert sensing and control into fixed-rate observation-action sequences, leaving physical time implicit in sequence position. This assumption breaks when observation rates or delays vary, or when inference latency changes. We introduce Chronos Policy, which makes physical time explicit by conditioning on observation capture times and desired action execution times. We study two ways to incorporate time into a diffusion transformer: adding timestamp embeddings to token features, or encoding physical time in positional encoding through time-aware rotary positional encodings (time-aware RoPE). We find that time-aware RoPE is more robust, allowing attention to depend directly on physical time while keeping token content unchanged. During training, we temporally randomize which observations are sampled and when the action chunk begins, exposing the policy to a wider range of sensing and execution schedules that may occur during deployments. This also enables learning from asynchronous, multi-rate data without forcing all measurements onto a fixed temporal grid. Across simulation and real-world experiments, Chronos Policy improves performance on dynamic tasks, where observation-to-action timing is critical, and on multisensory tasks, where the relative timing between observations matters. On standard quasi-static tasks, it preserves nominal performance while improving robustness to changes in sensing and inference timing.
papers.translated_summary: 机器人策略通常将传感与控制转换为固定频率的观测-动作序列，使物理时间隐含在序列位置中。当观测频率或延迟发生变化，或推理延迟改变时，这一假设便不再成立。我们提出Chronos Policy，通过以观测采集时间和期望动作执行时间为条件，使物理时间显式化。我们研究了两种将时间融入扩散Transformer的方式：向token特征添加时间戳嵌入，或通过时间感知旋转位置编码（time-aware RoPE）将物理时间编码进位置编码。我们发现时间感知RoPE更为稳健，它使注意力能够直接依赖于物理时间，同时保持token内容不变。在训练期间，我们对采样哪些观测以及动作块何时开始进行时间随机化，使策略暴露于部署期间可能出现的更广泛的传感与执行调度中。这也使得能够从异步、多速率数据中学习，而无需将所有测量强制对齐到固定时间网格上。在仿真和真实世界实验中，Chronos Policy在观测到动作的时序至关重要的动态任务上，以及在观测之间相对时序重要的多感官任务上，均提升了性能。在标准准静态任务上，它保持了标称性能，同时提升了对传感和推理时序变化的鲁棒性。

papers.title: AI Models Can Provably Hide Arbitrary Capabilities
papers.translated_title: AI模型可以可证明地隐藏任意能力
papers.author: Andis Draguns
papers.summary: Capability evaluations aim to surface dangerous model behaviors before deployment, but their reliability depends on the assumption that hidden capabilities can be elicited. We show this assumption does not hold under adversarial conditions by constructing backdoor attacks that embed encrypted neural networks within host model weights, decrypting and executing them only upon receiving a secret trigger. Using digital lockers, these hidden circuits remain provably hard to elicit and interpret under cryptographic assumptions, even given full access to model weights, extending prior work from hiding fixed strings to arbitrary computations. We implement our proof of concept constructions in PyTorch and evaluate elicitation through fine-tuning, weight noising, gradient-based trigger search, and latent adversarial training on a small chemical reaction prediction task - a proxy for CBRN-relevant capabilities. Our results demonstrate resistance to these methods and, together with our cryptographic guarantees, reveal a limit of elicitation-based capability audits. We release our models to support the improvement of defenses.
papers.translated_summary: 能力评估旨在部署前暴露模型的危险行为，但其可靠性依赖于一个假设：隐藏能力可以被诱发出来。我们通过构造后门攻击表明，这一假设在对抗条件下并不成立。这些攻击将加密神经网络嵌入宿主模型权重中，仅在收到秘密触发器时才解密并执行。利用数字锁柜，这些隐藏电路在密码学假设下可证明难以被诱发和解释，即使拥有对模型权重的完全访问权限，也将先前的工作从隐藏固定字符串扩展到任意计算。我们在PyTorch中实现了概念验证构造，并在一个小型化学反应预测任务上通过微调、权重加噪、基于梯度的触发器搜索和潜在对抗训练来评估诱发效果——该任务可作为CBRN相关能力的代理。我们的结果证明了对这些方法的抵抗力，并且结合我们的密码学保证，揭示了基于诱发的 capability audit 的局限性。我们发布模型以支持防御的改进。

papers.title: Can machines reason non-verbally?
papers.translated_title: 机器能进行非言语推理吗？
papers.author: Shaheer U. Saeed
papers.summary: Modern machines can solve equations, follow logic and reason through language, yet they still struggle with problems that require visual non-verbal reasoning. This is evident even in advanced systems such as DeepSeek, ChatGPT and Gemini, which remain limited on visual tasks such as completing abstract patterns or delineating ambiguous regions-of-interest. Unlike explicit intermediate steps in verbal reasoning which can be verified through logic or automated tests, visual reasoning involves implicit intermediate steps with no clear methods for verification. Non-verbal reasoning is therefore challenging to model and, as a result, remains a fundamental limitation of current machine intelligence. Here we introduce GenVerOpt, a general framework that unifies generation, verification and optimisation into a reasoning pipeline for machines. By generating candidate solutions, verifying their correctness, and iteratively refining them, GenVerOpt enables per-sample optimisation rather than relying solely on dataset-level trends captured during model training. This process mirrors human problem-solving where multiple possibilities are imagined, evaluated, and refined until a correct solution emerges. Across diverse domains, GenVerOpt demonstrates capabilities beyond existing systems: it surpasses humans on abstract IQ puzzles, matches clinicians in prostate cancer segmentation, exceeds experts in liver vessel reconstruction and outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in tumour boundary alignment. These results show that machine reasoning can extend beyond language, establishing visual non-verbal reasoning as a foundation for more flexible and generalisable intelligence.
papers.translated_summary: 现代机器能够解方程、遵循逻辑并通过语言进行推理，但在需要视觉非语言推理的问题上仍然举步维艰。这一点即使在DeepSeek、ChatGPT和Gemini等先进系统中也很明显，它们在完成抽象图案或勾勒模糊感兴趣区域等视觉任务上仍然存在局限。与语言推理中可通过逻辑或自动化测试验证的显式中间步骤不同，视觉推理涉及隐式中间步骤，且没有明确的验证方法。因此，非语言推理难以建模，并因此仍然是当前机器智能的一个根本性局限。在此，我们提出GenVerOpt，一个将生成、验证和优化统一为机器推理流水线的通用框架。通过生成候选解、验证其正确性并迭代改进，GenVerOpt能够实现逐样本优化，而非仅依赖模型训练过程中捕获的数据集层面趋势。这一过程类似于人类解决问题的方式：想象多种可能性，进行评估并不断改进，直到正确答案出现。在多个不同领域中，GenVerOpt展现出超越现有系统的能力：在抽象智商谜题上超越人类，在前列腺癌分割上媲美临床医生，在肝血管重建上超越专家，并在肿瘤边界对齐上优于最先进方法。这些结果表明，机器推理可以超越语言，将视觉非语言推理确立为更灵活、更具泛化能力的智能的基础。

papers.title: Human-specific CCG-repeat insertion in the RBFOX1 promoter implicated in autism and speech enhances EGR1-responsive activity
papers.translated_title: 人类特有的RBFOX1启动子中CCG重复插入与自闭症和语言相关，并增强EGR1响应性活性
papers.author: Lee, C.
papers.summary: Human-specific promoter innovations have been predicted to shape human-specific traits. Here, we investigated the RBFOX1 splice regulator gene, which is specifically upregulated in human and songbird speech/song brain areas. We found that the human RBFOX1 promoter associated with autism and language impairment harbors a human-specific CCG trinucleotide insertion creating a functional CCG-repeat motif. Comparative single-nucleus transcriptome analyses of primate brains indicate that the human promoter drives differential expression in cortical excitatory neurons. Reporter assays show that the human CCG-repeat motif, relative to the chimpanzee allele, increases promoter activity with the EGR1 transcription factor. Genome-wide, the CCG-repeat motif marks core promoters of 104 genes, related to postsynaptic function and autism. In PTCHD1, a clinical duplication in autism patients creates another CCG-repeat motif that similarly increases EGR1-responsive promoter activity. Our findings suggest that small CCG-repeat variants in regulatory regions can exert large effects on gene regulation and apparent associated traits.
papers.translated_summary: 人类特异性启动子创新被认为塑造了人类特异性性状。在此，我们研究了RBFOX1剪接调控基因，该基因在人类和鸣禽的言语/鸣唱脑区中特异性上调。我们发现，与自闭症和语言障碍相关的人类RBFOX1启动子携带一个人类特异性的CCG三核苷酸插入，产生了一个功能性CCG重复基序。灵长类脑的比较单核转录组分析表明，人类启动子在皮层兴奋性神经元中驱动差异表达。报告基因实验显示，相对于黑猩猩等位基因，人类CCG重复基序与EGR1转录因子共同增加了启动子活性。在全基因组范围内，CCG重复基序标记了104个基因的核心启动子，这些基因与突触后功能和自闭症相关。在PTCHD1中，自闭症患者中的一个临床重复产生了另一个CCG重复基序，同样增加了EGR1响应性启动子活性。我们的发现表明，调控区域中的小型CCG重复变异可以对基因调控及明显相关的性状产生巨大影响。

papers.title: A StayGold-based calcium ion indicator
papers.translated_title: 一种基于StayGold的钙离子指示剂
papers.author: Miyazaki, I.
papers.summary: Genetically encoded calcium ion (Ca2+) indicators (GECIs) enable visualization of Ca2+ dynamics in living systems but often suffer from limited photostability during prolonged imaging. The recent discovery of StayGold, a green fluorescent protein (FP) with exceptional brightness and photostability, opened the possibility of addressing this longstanding challenge. Here, we sought to establish whether a monomeric variant of StayGold (mStayGold) could be converted into a single FP-based GECI. Through extensive protein engineering, we generated a functional mStayGold-based GECI, HiCaRI (Highly intensiometric Ca2+ Responsive Indicator) by fusing Calmodulin (CaM) and the ckkap binding peptide from K-GECO1 into mStayGold(J). HiCaRI exhibits a large Ca2+-dependent inverse fluorescence response ({triangleup}F/Fmin = -15) while retaining high brightness and improved photostability relative to previously reported GFP-based GECIs. Although the current variant represents a first-generation prototype with shortcomings in terms of Ca2+ affinity and photostability (relative to StayGold and mStayGold(J)), this work demonstrates the feasibility of constructing single FP-based GECIs from a highly photostable fluorescent protein.
papers.translated_summary: 基因编码钙离子（Ca2+）指示剂（GECIs）能够可视化活体系统中的Ca2+动态变化，但在长时间成像过程中往往受限于光稳定性不足。近期发现的StayGold是一种具有卓越亮度和光稳定性的绿色荧光蛋白（FP），为解决这一长期挑战提供了可能。在此，我们试图确定StayGold的单体变体（mStayGold）能否被转化为基于单一FP的GECI。通过广泛的蛋白质工程改造，我们将钙调蛋白（CaM）和来自K-GECO1的ckkap结合肽融合到mStayGold(J)中，成功构建了一种功能性的基于mStayGold的GECI，命名为HiCaRI（高强度响应型Ca2+响应指示剂）。HiCaRI表现出大幅度的Ca2+依赖性反向荧光响应（{triangleup}F/Fmin = -15），同时相较于此前报道的基于GFP的GECIs，保留了高亮度并改善了光稳定性。尽管当前变体作为第一代原型，在Ca2+亲和力和光稳定性方面（相对于StayGold和mStayGold(J)）仍存在不足，但本工作证明了利用高度光稳定的荧光蛋白构建基于单一FP的GECIs的可行性。

papers.title: Pupil Dynamics Reflect Uncertainty-Driven Adjustments of Probability Learning
papers.translated_title: 瞳孔动态反映不确定性驱动的概率学习调整
papers.author: Greenhouse-Tucknott, A.
papers.summary: Adaptive learning in dynamic environments depends on the brain's ability to represent and respond to uncertainty. Changes in arousal-mediated pupil diameter provide insight into the neural basis of this process. Prior work has focused on magnitude-based inference tasks and revealed that learning is primarily influenced by the detection of change points and the corresponding modulation of arousal. In comparison, the role of arousal systems in learning contexts where changes are harder to detect, such as in probability learning, remains poorly understood. Here, we combined pupillometry with a probability learning task in which human participants estimated a hidden generative probability of stimuli that changed abruptly and unpredictably. A Bayesian ideal observer model was used to estimate trial-by-trial learning rates and two uncertainty-associated factors: change point probability (the probability that the generative process has abruptly changed) and prior uncertainty (about the current beliefs on this generative process). In line with normative theory, participants relied on prior uncertainty to adjust learning rates. Pupil analyses revealed temporally distinct representations of uncertainty, with phasic dilations tracking change point probability and tonic pupil dilations tracking prior uncertainty. Mediation analyses further indicated that both phasic and tonic pupil signals partially carried the effects of change point probability and prior uncertainty on learning, respectively. Critically, high tonic arousal weakened the coupling between phasic pupil responses and change point probability, accompanied by a reduced influence of change point probability on learning. Together, our results demonstrate that probability learning in a dynamic environment is underpinned by computationally rational integration of latent uncertainty factors and its contribution to belief updating,regulated through arousal-associated responses.
papers.translated_summary: 动态环境中的适应性学习依赖于大脑表征和响应不确定性的能力。唤醒介导的瞳孔直径变化为理解这一过程的神经基础提供了洞见。先前的研究主要集中于基于量值的推理任务，并揭示学习主要受变化点检测及相应唤醒调节的影响。相比之下，在变化更难检测的学习情境中，例如概率学习，唤醒系统的作用仍知之甚少。在此，我们将瞳孔测量法与概率学习任务相结合，在该任务中，人类参与者估计刺激的一个隐藏生成概率，该概率会突然且不可预测地发生变化。我们使用贝叶斯理想观察者模型来估计逐试次的学习率以及两个与不确定性相关的因素：变化点概率（生成过程突然发生变化的概率）和先验不确定性（关于当前对该生成过程信念的不确定性）。与规范性理论一致，参与者依赖先验不确定性来调整学习率。瞳孔分析揭示了不确定性在时间上不同的表征：相位性瞳孔扩张追踪变化点概率，而紧张性瞳孔扩张追踪先验不确定性。中介分析进一步表明，相位性和紧张性瞳孔信号分别部分承载了变化点概率和先验不确定性对学习的影响。关键的是，高紧张性唤醒削弱了相位性瞳孔反应与变化点概率之间的耦合，并伴随着变化点概率对学习影响的降低。总之，我们的结果表明，动态环境中的概率学习由对潜在不确定性因素的计算理性整合及其对信念更新的贡献所支撑，并通过与唤醒相关的反应进行调节。

papers.title: Environmental co-option of chromatin potential links prenatal hypoxia to persistent cortical circuit dysfunction
papers.translated_title: 产前缺氧通过环境对染色质潜能的共选择导致持续性皮层回路功能障碍
papers.author: Cristancho, A. G.
papers.summary: Transient prenatal hypoxia is associated with long-term neurodevelopmental impairment without overt structural brain injury, suggesting early regulatory disruptions precede detectable pathology. Whether these disruptions represent transient stress responses or redirect developmental programs remains unknown. Here, we combined single-nucleus RNA sequencing and chromatin accessibility profiling in the late-gestation mouse cortex immediately after transient hypoxia, capturing responses across more than 140,000 nuclei. Hypoxia induced a largely conserved transcriptional stress response across cell types, whereas chromatin accessibility showed more extensive, cell type-specific disruption. Developing glutamatergic neurons showed the strongest disruption of chromatin transcription coupling, with hypoxia-responsive distal regulatory regions associated with genes governing synaptic organization and neuronal excitability. Consistent with these chromatin-associated programs, juvenile offspring displayed reduced dendritic spine density and increased intrinsic excitability in cortical neurons. These results support a model in which transient hypoxia co-opts the developing epigenome's capacity to encode future transcriptional states before persistent circuit dysfunction emerges.
papers.translated_summary: 短暂产前缺氧与长期神经发育障碍相关，且不伴有明显的结构性脑损伤，提示早期调控紊乱先于可检测的病理变化。这些紊乱究竟代表短暂的应激反应，还是改变了发育程序，目前尚不清楚。在此，我们结合单核RNA测序和染色质可及性分析，在短暂缺氧后立即对妊娠晚期小鼠皮层进行研究，捕获了超过140,000个细胞核的反应。缺氧在各细胞类型中诱导了 largely 保守的转录应激反应，而染色质可及性则表现出更广泛的、细胞类型特异性的紊乱。发育中的谷氨酸能神经元表现出最强的染色质-转录偶联紊乱，其缺氧响应性远端调控区域与调控突触组织和神经元兴奋性的基因相关。与这些染色质相关程序一致，幼年子代皮层神经元表现出树突棘密度降低和内在兴奋性增加。这些结果支持这样一种模型：在持续性环路功能障碍出现之前，短暂缺氧劫持了发育中表观基因组编码未来转录状态的能力。

papers.title: The essential role of connective-tissue cells during axolotl limb regeneration
papers.translated_title: 结缔组织细胞在蝾螈肢体再生中的关键作用
papers.author: Garcia-Garcia, D.
papers.summary: Axolotls (Ambystoma mexicanum) are known for their remarkable limb-regeneration abilities, which involve the formation of the blastema, a specialized structure consisting of progenitor cells contributed by all major tissues of the limb. Lateral plate mesoderm (LPM)-derived connective tissue (CT) cells dedifferentiate and play a critical role in blastema formation and subsequent limb regeneration. However, the complexity of the blastema cellular composition and the extent of CT participation and necessity have not been rigorously explored. To address this gap, we conducted spatial transcriptomics using a select array of probes, revealing that CT cells constitute up to 75% of the blastema cells. Genetic ablation of CT cells significantly delays or truncates limb regeneration, underscoring their necessity during this process. Analysis of the molecular profile during blastema formation identifies a temporally ordered gene expression pattern reflecting sequential phases of CT cell dedifferentiation, proliferation, and redifferentiation. Finally, a cell-cell communication inference identifies a CT-cell-autonomous FGFR1/AKT1 signaling axis as a cell-intrinsic molecular requirement for limb regeneration. Together, our work reaffirms the central role of CT cells in axolotl limb regeneration and lays the foundation for identifying molecular mechanisms that govern blastema formation during the initial phases of limb regeneration.
papers.translated_summary: 墨西哥钝口螈（Ambystoma mexicanum）以其卓越的肢体再生能力而闻名，这一过程涉及芽基的形成，芽基是一种由肢体所有主要组织贡献的祖细胞组成的特化结构。侧板中胚层（LPM）来源的结缔组织（CT）细胞去分化，并在芽基形成及随后的肢体再生中发挥关键作用。然而，芽基细胞组成的复杂性以及CT参与的程度和必要性尚未得到严格探究。为填补这一空白，我们使用选定探针阵列进行了空间转录组学分析，揭示CT细胞占芽基细胞的比例高达75%。CT细胞的遗传消融显著延迟或截断肢体再生，凸显了其在这一过程中的必要性。对芽基形成过程中分子谱的分析鉴定出一个时间有序的基因表达模式，反映了CT细胞去分化、增殖和再分化的连续阶段。最后，细胞间通讯推断鉴定出一条CT细胞自主的FGFR1/AKT1信号轴，作为肢体再生的一种细胞内在分子需求。总之，我们的工作再次证实了CT细胞在墨西哥钝口螈肢体再生中的核心作用，并为鉴定在肢体再生初始阶段调控芽基形成的分子机制奠定了基础。

papers.title: Seasonal Selection Reveals Two Independent Temporal Modes of Genomic Adaptation
papers.translated_title: 季节性选择揭示了基因组适应的两种独立时间模式
papers.author: Behrman, E. L.
papers.summary: Natural populations must adapt to environmental change that unfolds over multiple, overlapping timescales, yet how they do so remains a central question in evolutionary biology. Here we combine seven years of field sampling, common-garden phenotyping and pooled whole-genome sequencing from a single wild Drosophila melanogaster population. We identify two independent modes of selection: a concurrent mode, in which allele frequencies track the environment of the current season, and a lagged mode, in which the environment of one season drives allele-frequency change in the next. The two modes act on largely distinct sets of SNPs, and each responds to different environmental variables depending on which season is exerting selection. Selection signals from different seasons and timings converge on the same genes, and this convergence increases with both pleiotropy and breadth of selection: genes that affect more stress-tolerance traits, and genes that respond to more season-and-timing combinations, are the most likely to be targeted repeatedly. These genes are concentrated in neural and developmental pathways, including genes that govern reproductive behaviour. Our results show that populations adapt to environmental change through multiple strategies that differ in both timing and genomic basis, and that reshape how the organism perceives and responds to its environment. This principle should extend to any system that faces recurring, structured environmental variation.
papers.translated_summary: 自然种群必须适应在多个重叠时间尺度上展开的环境变化，但它们如何做到这一点仍是进化生物学的核心问题。在此，我们结合了对一个野生黑腹果蝇种群长达七年的野外采样、同质园表型分析和混合全基因组测序。我们识别出两种独立的选择模式：一种是同步模式，其中等位基因频率追踪当季的环境；另一种是滞后模式，其中一个季节的环境驱动下一季的等位基因频率变化。这两种模式作用于 largely 不同的SNP集合，并且各自根据施加选择的季节对不同环境变量作出响应。来自不同季节和时序的选择信号汇聚于相同的基因，而这种汇聚随多效性和选择广度的增加而增加：影响更多胁迫耐受性状的基因，以及对更多季节-时序组合作出响应的基因，最有可能被反复靶向。这些基因集中在神经和发育通路中，包括控制繁殖行为的基因。我们的结果表明，种群通过多种在时间和基因组基础上均有所不同的策略来适应环境变化，并重塑了生物体感知和响应其环境的方式。这一原理应可推广至任何面临反复出现的、结构化环境变化的系统。

papers.title: Distribution of Gene Tree Topologies with Duplication, Loss, and Coalescence
papers.translated_title: 带有复制、丢失和溯祖的基因树拓扑分布
papers.author: Mishra, S.
papers.summary: Motivation: Many methods can be used to infer the number and timing of gene duplication and loss events from gene trees. Most such reconciliation methods use a model of gene duplication that does not include the coalescent process, or that restricts it in important ways. As a result, changes to tree topologies due to coalescence will incur a cost of extra duplications and losses using these methods, events that did not actually occur. Results: Here, we present results from the multispecies coalescent with duplication and loss (MSC-DL) model, which allows for the unrestricted interaction between duplication, loss, and coalescence. Theoretical results show that even histories with only a single duplication event can lead to many more trees than are normally considered: for a species tree with 2 tips, 9 trees are possible, while with 6 tips, more than 19 million trees are possible; adding even a single loss almost doubles the number of possible topologies. The probabilities of different topologies and their branch lengths under the MSC-DL for trees with two species are calculated exactly, and we provide an approach for calculating such probabilities on larger trees. These results have important implications for the accuracy of reconciliation methods, ortholog identification methods, and our understanding of evolutionary histories of duplication and loss. Supplementary Information: Supplementary materials are available at https://github.com/smishra677/ Distribution-of-Gene-Tree-Topologies-with-Duplication-Loss-and-Coalescence.
papers.translated_summary: 动机：许多方法可用于从基因树推断基因复制和丢失事件的数量与时间。大多数此类调和方法使用的基因复制模型不包含溯祖过程，或对其施加重要限制。因此，由溯祖导致的树拓扑变化在这些方法下会带来额外复制和丢失的代价，而这些事件实际上并未发生。结果：在此，我们展示了来自多物种溯祖与复制和丢失（MSC-DL）模型的结果，该模型允许复制、丢失和溯祖之间不受限制的相互作用。理论结果表明，即使仅包含单次复制事件的历史，也可能导致比通常认为的更多的树：对于具有2个末端物种的物种树，可能有9棵树；而对于6个末端物种，可能有超过1900万棵树；即使仅增加一次丢失，也几乎使可能的拓扑数量翻倍。对于包含两个物种的树，我们在MSC-DL下精确计算了不同拓扑及其分支长度的概率，并提供了一种在更大树上计算此类概率的方法。这些结果对调和方法的准确性、直系同源识别方法以及我们对复制和丢失进化历史的理解具有重要意义。补充信息：补充材料可在 https://github.com/smishra677/ Distribution-of-Gene-Tree-Topologies-with-Duplication-Loss-and-Coalescence 获取。

papers.title: AmyloCore-ML: AI/Machine Learning Enabled Identification of Amyloid Fibril Core Regions Using Protein Language Models
papers.translated_title: AmyloCore-ML：基于蛋白质语言模型的AI/机器学习识别淀粉样纤维核心区域
papers.author: Singh, J.
papers.summary: Identification of amyloid forming regions in proteins remains central to understanding of their aggregation behaviour, which are central to various neurodegenerative and systemic disorders. Many predictors have been designed to identify amyloid forming regions, however they may not necessarily identify total residues found in actual disease associated fibril structures. To address this, we formed a sequence-based based predictor-AmyloCore-ML to ascertain structural amyloid-core propensity. The predictor was developed using experimentally determined fibril structures obtained from Amyloid Atlas. Ordered residues in the experimental structures were designated as core, and unresolved sampled from the same proteins as matched controls as non-core. Core and non-core regions were encoded using various physicochemical descriptors and protein language model (PLM) embeddings (ESM-2, ANKH, ProtT5) and evaluated using protein-grouped cross-validation. papers.title: MtbAIM: AI/ML-guided endpoint-specific prediction of small-molecule activity across drug-susceptible and drug-resistant Mycobacterium tuberculosis

papers.author: Singh, J.
papers.summary: The emergence of drug resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis (M.tb) presents a major challenge to drug discovery, as compounds active against drug-susceptible (DS) isolates may not retain comparable inhibitory activity against drug-resistant (DR) isolates. Here, we developed an AI/ML workflow to independently prioritize small molecules separately against DS and DR isolates of M.tb and predict MIC, MIC90, and MIC99 as distinct quantitative endpoints. Following curation of data retrieved from the ChEMBL repository, molecular-activity datasets comprised 25,645 and 3,749 compounds tested against whole cell DS and DR isolates respectively. Molecular representations were generated using RDKit descriptors and Morgan fingerprints, along with embeddings from ChemBERTa, MolCLR, and Uni-Mol, and evaluated for binary activity classification and endpoint-specific regression. The best-performing DS classifier combined RDKit/Morgan features with ExtraTrees (balanced accuracy 0.782; AUROC 0.864; AUPRC 0.870), while histogram gradient boosting using the same features performed best for DR classification (balanced accuracy 0.762; AUROC 0.836; AUPRC 0.880). Similarly, RDKit/Morgan features combined with tree-based regressors achieved the best overall performance across all six DS/DR regression endpoints, with pooled out-of-fold RMSE values ranging from 0.604 to 0.784 pMIC units. To facilitate broader application, we developed MtbAIM (https://github.com/jasdeep002/MtbAIM), a Google Colab-based prediction platform that enables users to assess and prioritize small molecules against DS and DR isolates of M.tb.

papers.title: Non-canonical cleavage expands prime editing in 5' direction

papers.author: Chen, P.-R.
papers.summary: Cleavage-dependent CRISPR-Cas gene editing relies on RNA-guided DNA cleavage that drives cellular machinery to incorporate intended edits. Beyond canonical cleavage, CRISPR nucleases can also execute non-canonical cleavage on the displaced DNA strand. Here, we report a modified design principle for prime editing that leverages the non-canonical cleavage activity, enabling editing in the 5' direction of a classic nick site. We elucidate the non-canonical-cleavage-driven reverse transcription pathway that initiates upstream of the classic nick site. We identify competition between the canonical and non-canonical routes, which can be modulated by rationally designing RNA templates carrying the intended edits. We demonstrate that cellular physiology enhances editing efficiency from individual reverse-transcription product yet exerts limited influence on pathway competitions. Our findings revise the design principle of prime editing and establish a new dimension for engineering CRISPR-Cas systems by harnessing its intrinsic, non-host-specific, non-canonical cleavage activity.

papers.title: Physicians' Industrial Action: An Interrupted Time Series Analysis Assessing Impact in 11 Kenyan Neonatal Units
papers.translated_title: 医生工业行动：一项中断时间序列分析评估对肯尼亚11个新生儿病房的影响
papers.author: Paral, M. M.
papers.summary: Background. Skilled healthcare workers are essential for neonatal survival; however, the Kenyan public health system has historically faced strikes compounded by a human resource crisis. Evidence on how strikes affect neonatal care and mortality remains limited. This study evaluated changes in neonatal admissions, clinical care processes, and inpatient mortality associated with 56 days of disruption during the 2024 Kenyan physicians' strike. Methods. We conducted a retrospective interrupted time-series analysis of 12,184 admissions to 11 Kenyan neonatal units implementing with the NEST360 Alliance, recorded in the Neonatal Inpatient Dataset from December 2023 to August 2024. Weekly admissions and inpatient mortality were modeled over a 72-week window (27,638 admissions) using hospital-clustered generalized estimating equations with seasonal terms. Care processes, case fatality, and birthweight-specific mortality were compared across study periods. Results. Weekly admissions fell from 413 to 189 during the strike (incidence rate ratio (IRR) 0.49, 95% confidence interval (CI) 0.31-0.75), approximately 1,700 fewer admissions than expected, and returned to baseline afterward (IRR 1.00, CI 0.81-1.23). Newborns admitted during the strike were of lower birthweight, more often premature, and more often outborn. Admissions fell across all birth-location categories, most steeply among inborn neonates. No measurable change was detected in documented inpatient coverage of care measures, in crude mortality (12.5% to 14.9%; risk ratio (RR) 1.07, CI 0.85-1.33), or in trend-adjusted mortality (IRR 0.88, CI 0.53-1.45). Case fatality among neonates with recorded infection doubled, from 4.7% to 9.6% (RR 2.06, CI 1.18-3.58; adjusted p = 0.047). Conclusions. The 2024 physicians' strike was associated with severe disruption to neonatal service utilization, with admissions returning to baseline when the strike ended. Among newborns who continued to reach care, inpatient mortality did not change measurably, but case fatality among those with recorded infection doubled. This analysis was confined to inpatient data; hence, the outcomes of newborns who did not reach the hospitals were not captured. Both inpatient and population-level data are needed to assess the full impact of the strike. Mitigating harm during future labor disruptions requires interventions such as resilient care models, formalized task-shifting protocols, and minimum service coverage agreements.
papers.translated_summary: 背景。熟练的医护人员对新生儿生存至关重要；然而，肯尼亚公共卫生系统历来面临罢工，并叠加人力资源危机。关于罢工如何影响新生儿护理和死亡率，证据仍然有限。本研究评估了2024年肯尼亚医生罢工期间56天的中断与新生儿入院、临床护理流程和住院死亡率变化之间的关联。方法。我们对肯尼亚11个实施NEST360 Alliance的新生儿病房的12，184例入院进行了回顾性中断时间序列分析，数据记录于2023年12月至2024年8月的Neonatal Inpatient Dataset。我们使用按医院聚类的广义估计方程并纳入季节性项，在72周窗口内（27，638例入院）对每周入院和住院死亡率进行建模。我们比较了各研究期间的护理流程、病死率和出生体重别死亡率。结果。罢工期间每周入院从413降至189（发病率比（IRR）0.49，95%置信区间（CI）0.31-0.75），比预期约少1，700例入院，之后恢复至基线水平（IRR 1.00，CI 0.81-1.23）。罢工期间入院的新生儿出生体重更低、更常为早产、更常为院外出生。各出生地点类别的入院均下降，其中院内出生新生儿下降最陡。在记录的住院护理覆盖措施、粗死亡率（12.5%至14.9%；风险比（RR）1.07，CI 0.85-1.33）或趋势校正死亡率（IRR 0.88，CI 0.53-1.45）方面，未检测到可测量的变化。有感染记录新生儿的病死率翻倍，从4.7%升至9.6%（RR 2.06，CI 1.18-3.58；校正p = 0.047）。结论。2024年医生罢工与新生儿服务利用的严重中断相关，罢工结束后入院恢复至基线水平。在仍能获得救治的新生儿中，住院死亡率未发生可测量的变化，但有感染记录者的病死率翻倍。本分析仅限于住院数据；因此，未能到达医院的新生儿结局未被捕获。需要住院和人群层面数据来评估罢工的全面影响。为减轻未来劳动力中断期间的危害，需要采取干预措施，如具有韧性的护理模式、正式化的任务转移方案和最低服务覆盖协议。

papers.title: Comparing immersive mindfulness and nature interventions for managing preoperative distress in breast cancer patients: A randomized controlled trial.
papers.translated_title: 比较沉浸式正念与自然干预在管理乳腺癌患者术前痛苦中的效果：一项随机对照试验。
papers.author: Pinto, D.
papers.summary: Preoperative distress in breast cancer patients is highly prevalent and associated with adverse post-surgical outcomes. While both virtual reality (VR) distraction and mindfulness exercises have been increasingly utilized to manage this distress, the clinical impact of integrating active mindfulness meditation into the immersive experience remains under-investigated. Here, we present a pilot randomized controlled trial evaluating the feasibility, acceptability and preliminary efficacy of brief, first-time immersive nature and mindfulness interventions for patients admitted to the holding area prior to the operating room for breast cancer surgery. Sixty participants were randomized to receive an 8-minute preoperative VR experience with mindfulness instruction (VR+Meditation), a standard VR nature experience without audio guidance (VR Only), or Care-as-Usual (CAU). The intervention was feasible and well tolerated with zero patient dropout and minimal indications of cybersickness or general discomfort. Outcomes included patient-reported anxiety and fear, physiological measures, and a computational semantic analysis of post-operative patient interviews. Compared with standard care, both VR interventions significantly reduced self-reported anxiety and heart rate. Although no significant differences were observed between the two active intervention groups, the VR+Meditation group demonstrated a significant and clinically meaningful reduction in surgery-specific fear relative to standard care. Analysis of brief patient interviews provided convergent evidence supporting these findings, showing that patients receiving VR+Meditation used language more strongly aligned with relief than those receiving standard care. These findings suggest that immersive VR represents a feasible and well-tolerated first-time immersive intervention for reducing preoperative distress in patients undergoing breast cancer surgery. The addition of guided mindfulness may provide additional benefit by specifically addressing surgery-related fear, supporting the hypothesis that different digital interventions may target distinct dimensions of preoperative distress. Larger randomized studies are warranted to confirm these preliminary findings. Author summaryWaiting for breast cancer surgery is an incredibly stressful experience, and high levels of anxiety before an operation can negatively impact a patients recovery and mental health. Because surgical wards are fast-paced, providing individualized psychological support in the moments just before an operation is challenging. In this study, we tested whether an immersive Virtual Reality (VR) experience may help reduce preoperative distress by transporting patients to a calming digital environment immediately before surgery. We compared standard VR distraction with the same immersive experience combined with guided mindfulness meditation. Both VR interventions reduced anxiety and heart rate compared with standard care. Only the group receiving VR with guided mindfulness showed a significant reduction in surgery-related fear and, when describing their experience after surgery, used language more strongly associated with relief. Our findings suggest that immersive interventions provided to patients for the first time on the day of surgery can provide simple, well-tolerated psychological support during one of the most stressful moments in the patient journey. They also suggest that different digital approaches may influence different aspects of preoperative distress, with guided mindfulness offering additional support for surgery-related fear.
papers.translated_summary: 乳腺癌患者术前痛苦非常普遍，并与不良术后结局相关。尽管虚拟现实（VR）分散注意力和正念练习已被越来越多地用于管理这种痛苦，但将主动正念冥想整合到沉浸式体验中的临床影响仍缺乏充分研究。在此，我们报告一项初步随机对照试验，评估在乳腺癌手术患者于手术室前等待区接受简短的、首次沉浸式自然与正念干预的可行性、可接受性和初步疗效。六十名参与者被随机分配接受8分钟术前VR体验并配有正念指导（VR+冥想）、无音频指导的标准VR自然体验（仅VR）或常规护理（CAU）。该干预可行且耐受良好，无患者脱落，且几乎没有晕动症或一般不适的迹象。结局包括患者报告的焦虑和恐惧、生理测量指标，以及对术后患者访谈的计算语义分析。与标准护理相比，两种VR干预均显著降低了自我报告的焦虑和心率。尽管两个主动干预组之间未观察到显著差异，但与标准护理相比，VR+冥想组在手术特异性恐惧方面表现出显著且具有临床意义的降低。对简短患者访谈的分析提供了支持这些发现的 convergent 证据，显示接受VR+冥想治疗的患者使用的语言比接受标准护理的患者更强烈地与 relief 一致。这些发现表明，沉浸式VR代表了一种可行且耐受良好的首次沉浸式干预，可用于减轻接受乳腺癌手术患者的术前痛苦。加入引导式正念可能通过专门针对手术相关恐惧提供额外益处，支持不同数字干预可能针对术前痛苦不同维度的假设。需要更大规模的随机研究来确认这些初步发现。作者摘要等待乳腺癌手术是一种极其紧张的经历，术前高水平的焦虑会对患者的康复和心理健康产生负面影响。由于外科病房节奏很快，在手术前片刻提供个体化心理支持具有挑战性。在这项研究中，我们测试了一种沉浸式虚拟现实（VR）体验是否可以通过在手术前立即将患者带入平静的数字环境来帮助减轻术前痛苦。我们比较了标准VR分散注意力与结合引导式正念冥想的相同沉浸式体验。与标准护理相比，两种VR干预均降低了焦虑和心率。只有接受VR结合引导式正念的组表现出手术相关恐惧的显著降低，并且在描述术后体验时，使用了与 relief 更强烈相关的语言。我们的发现表明，在手术当天首次向患者提供的沉浸式干预，可以在患者旅程中最紧张的时刻之一提供简单、耐受良好的心理支持。它们还表明，不同的数字方法可能影响术前痛苦的不同方面，其中引导式正念为手术相关恐惧提供了额外支持。

papers.title: Electronic health record (EHR)-detectable statin intolerance phenotypes: Prevalence and validation in real-world general practice

papers.author: Rakhshanda, S.
papers.summary: Aims: This study aimed to identify patients with statin intolerance and estimate the prevalence of statin intolerance among patients prescribed statins for primary prevention of cardiovascular disease using electronic health record (EHR) data. It also aimed to identify, implement, and evaluate the performance of EHR-detectable electronic phenotyping algorithms for statin intolerance. Methods: This study used the Electronic Practice Based Research Network (ePBRN) dataset. The methodology took place in four stages: (1) a literature review to identify EHR-detectable phenotyping algorithms for statin intolerance, (2) implementation of the identified algorithms in the ePBRN dataset, (3) development and implementation of a reference standard, and (4) evaluation of algorithm performance against the reference standard. Results: Six EHR-detectable electronic phenotyping algorithms for statin intolerance were identified, including the Minnesota Combined Rule-Based algorithm, Japan statin induced myopathy (SIMs), USA SIMs, Singapore SIMs (algorithms A, B, C, and D), Japan statin-associated muscle toxicity (SAMT), and NHS-UK statin intolerance pathway. The prevalence of statin intolerance in the ePBRN dataset was 5.09%. No algorithm performed consistently well across all performance measures. The Singapore SIMs-B algorithm showed the highest accuracy (57.05%), sensitivity (92.95%), negative predictive value (43.43%), and F1 (71.51%) scores, while the Japan SAMT algorithm showed the highest specificity (99.13%), and positive predictive value (76.19%). Overall correspondence with the reference standard was weak, with correlation coefficients ranging from approximately -0.02 to 0.05. Conclusion: The prevalence of statin intolerance in ePBRN dataset was at the lower end of the 5-15% estimates reported in Australia and internationally. The performances of the evaluated algorithms varied substantially across screening and classification measures, and no single algorithm demonstrated consistently strong performance. These findings highlight the challenges of identifying statin intolerance using routinely collected EHR data and support further development and validation of EHR-detectable phenotyping approaches before their use in clinical decision-support.

papers.title: Interventions to manage intolerance among patients prescribed statins for primary prevention of cardiovascular diseases: A systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.translated_title: 管理他汀类药物用于心血管疾病一级预防患者不耐受性的干预措施：系统综述与荟萃分析
papers.author: Rakhshanda, S.
papers.summary: The objective of this systematic review and meta-analysis was to identify the interventions used to manage intolerance in patients receiving statins for primary prevention of CVD and to determine the effectiveness of these interventions. This study was conducted according to the PRISMA checklist. The electronic databases MEDLINE (PubMed), SCOPUS, EMBASE, and CINAHL were searched for studies published until June 2025. Based on the NLA definition of statin intolerance, the outcomes were split into adverse effects caused by statins and statin discontinuation. In total, 1,238 studies were identified and screened. Nine studies were eligible for systematic review, and six studies were eligible for meta-analysis. The identified intervention strategies were adjuvant therapy, statin titration, replacing statins with other lipid-lowering agents and switching to different statin. The meta-analysis showed that the pooled risk ratio (RR) relative to control was 0.97 (95% CI, 0.86-1.08) in randomized controlled trials and 0.94 (95% CI, 0.63-1.42) in overall, with point estimates in favour of intervention arms. Moderate to substantial heterogeneity was observed, with I2 between 27% to 57%. Due to the smaller number of studies, no clear conclusions can be drawn regarding how the implemented interventions may affect statin discontinuation. This study showed no strong evidence that the implemented interventions reduced statin intolerance.
papers.translated_summary: 本系统综述与荟萃分析旨在识别用于管理接受他汀类药物进行心血管疾病一级预防患者不耐受的干预措施，并确定这些干预措施的有效性。本研究按照PRISMA清单进行。检索了MEDLINE（PubMed）、SCOPUS、EMBASE和CINAHL电子数据库中截至2025年6月发表的文献。基于NLA对他汀类药物不耐受的定义，结局分为他汀类药物引起的不良反应和他汀类药物停药。共识别并筛选了1，238项研究。9项研究符合系统综述的纳入标准，6项研究符合荟萃分析的纳入标准。所识别的干预策略包括辅助治疗、他汀类药物剂量滴定、用其他降脂药物替代他汀类药物以及换用不同他汀类药物。荟萃分析显示，相对于对照组的合并风险比（RR）在随机对照试验中为0.97（95% CI，0.86-1.08），总体为0.94（95% CI，0.63-1.42），点估计值倾向于干预组。观察到中度至显著异质性，I2在27%至57%之间。由于研究数量较少，无法就所实施的干预措施如何影响他汀类药物停药得出明确结论。本研究表明，没有强有力的证据表明所实施的干预措施减少了他汀类药物不耐受。

papers.title: Polygenic risk of cardiovascular disease manifests in cardiac structure and function
papers.translated_title: 心血管疾病的多基因风险体现在心脏结构和功能上
papers.author: Felici, B.
papers.summary: Cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) are highly heritable, but pathogenesis at the organ and physiological level remains poorly defined. Polygenic risk scores (PRSs), which estimate individual genetic susceptibility to a disease, may allow for the identification of associated subclinical structural abnormalities. Ultimately, identifying where cardiovascular polygenic risk manifests can shape mechanistic hypotheses, guide early interventions, and motivate prevention trials for cardiac remodelling. This study investigated the cardiac features associated with elevated polygenic risk for five common CVDs [heart failure (HF), coronary artery disease (CAD), atrial fibrillation (AF), abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) and ischaemic stroke (IS)] using 28 imaging-derived phenotypes (IDPs) from cardiac magnetic resonance imaging of ~62,000 participants in the UK Biobank cohort. We identified 97 significant PRS-IDP associations as well as 71 IDP-incident disease associations (FDR [≤] 0.05). We further identified 32 significant putative mediators between CVD PRSs and incident disease events, revealing that across CVDs, polygenic risk manifested as distinct patterns in cardiac structures. HF implicated all cardiac chambers, particularly left ventricular and left atrial dysfunction alongside enlarged aorta. AF was characterised by biatrial enlargement and reduced ejection fractions, most prominently in the left atrium. IS and CAD predominantly involved left ventricular hypertrophy, specifically left ventricular wall thickness for IS, whereas AAA was mainly characterised by enlarged descending aorta. Overall, our findings empirically demonstrate that cardiac IDPs partially mediate polygenic risk for CVDs, uncovering a heterogeneous landscape of organ-level mechanisms across CVDs.
papers.translated_summary: 心血管疾病具有高度遗传性，但其在器官和生理层面的发病机制仍不明确。多基因风险评分用于估计个体对某种疾病的遗传易感性，可能有助于识别相关的亚临床结构异常。最终，确定心血管多基因风险在何处显现，可以为机制假说提供依据、指导早期干预，并推动针对心脏重构的预防试验。本研究利用英国生物银行队列中约62000名参与者心脏磁共振成像衍生的28种影像衍生表型，研究了与五种常见心血管疾病[心力衰竭、冠状动脉疾病、心房颤动、腹主动脉瘤和缺血性卒中]多基因风险升高相关的心脏特征。我们识别出97个显著的PRS-IDP关联以及71个IDP- incident disease关联。我们进一步识别出32个介于CVD PRS与incident disease事件之间的显著推定中介因子，揭示出在不同CVD中，多基因风险表现为不同的心脏结构模式。HF涉及所有心腔，尤其是左心室和左心房功能障碍，并伴有主动脉增大。AF以双心房扩大和射血分数降低为特征，其中左心房最为突出。IS和CAD主要涉及左心室肥厚，其中IS具体表现为左心室壁厚度增加，而AAA主要以降主动脉增大为特征。总体而言，我们的发现从经验上证明，心脏IDP部分中介了CVD的多基因风险，揭示了不同CVD在器官层面机制上的异质性图景。

papers.title: Daily Exceedance of World Health Organization Air Pollutant Guidelines and Cognitive Aging
papers.translated_title: 世界卫生组织空气污染物指导值的每日超标与认知老化
papers.author: Bloomberg, M.
papers.summary: Importance: Long-term exposure to higher average air pollutant concentrations is associated with poorer cognitive health, but annual averages can obscure substantial differences in day-to-day exposure. Whether recurrent high pollution days are associated with long-term cognitive aging trajectories among people with similar overall air pollution exposure is unclear. Objective: To determine whether the annual number of days exceeding World Health Organization daily guideline values for nitrogen dioxide (NO2) and particulate matter (PM2.5 and PM10) is associated with subsequent cognitive decline after accounting for annual mean air pollutant exposure. Design: Prospective cohort study using data from waves 1-10 (2002-03 to 2021-23) of the English Longitudinal Study of Ageing. Setting: Population-based cohort of community-dwelling adults in England. Participants: 12,235 adults aged 50+ years at analytic baseline. Exposures: Number of days exceeding World Health Organization daily guideline values ('exceedance days') for NO2, PM2.5, and PM10, derived from residence-linked environmental estimates during the calendar year preceding the analytic baseline. Main Outcomes and Measures: Baseline cognitive performance and model-estimated 14-year cognitive decline (corresponding to the 75th percentile of follow-up duration) in episodic memory and verbal fluency. Results: Exceedance days were not associated with baseline memory or verbal fluency after adjustment for annual mean air pollutant exposure. More NO2 exceedance days were associated with faster cognitive decline: comparing the 75th percentile with the median of NO2 exceedance days, the difference in 14-year decline was -0.09 SD (95% CI, -0.17 to -0.01; p = 0.02) for memory and -0.10 SD (95% CI, -0.19 to 0.00; p = 0.04) for fluency. PM2.5 and PM10 exceedance days were not associated with cognitive decline. Conclusions and Relevance: In this cohort study of older adults, a higher number of NO2 exceedance days was associated with faster subsequent cognitive decline after adjustment for annual mean air pollutant exposure. This suggests that daily exposure to high NO2 concentrations may be related to accelerated cognitive aging even when offset by lower exposure on other days, potentially providing a new rationale for identifying and prioritizing areas with recurrent high NO2 exposure and the local emission sources contributing to it.
papers.translated_summary: 重要性：长期暴露于较高的平均空气污染物浓度与较差的认知健康相关，但年均值可能掩盖日常暴露的巨大差异。在总体空气污染暴露相似的人群中，反复出现的高污染天数是否与长期认知衰老轨迹相关尚不清楚。目的：确定在考虑年均空气污染物暴露后，超过世界卫生组织二氧化氮（NO2）和颗粒物（PM2.5和PM10）每日指导值的年天数是否与随后的认知下降相关。设计：前瞻性队列研究，使用英国老龄化纵向研究第1-10波（2002-03至2021-23）的数据。地点：英格兰社区居住成年人的基于人群的队列。参与者：分析基线时12,235名50岁及以上成年人。暴露：在分析基线前日历年期间，根据与住所关联的环境估计得出的超过世界卫生组织每日指导值的天数（“超标天数”），涉及NO2、PM2.5和PM10。主要结局和指标：基线认知表现以及模型估计的14年情景记忆和言语流畅性认知下降（对应于随访时长的第75百分位数）。结果：在调整年均空气污染物暴露后，超标天数与基线记忆或言语流畅性无关。更多NO2超标天数与更快的认知下降相关：将NO2超标天数的第75百分位数与中位数进行比较，14年下降差异为记忆-0.09 SD（95% CI，-0.17至-0.01；p = 0.02），言语流畅性-0.10 SD（95% CI，-0.19至0.00；p = 0.04）。PM2.5和PM10超标天数与认知下降无关。结论与意义：在这项老年人队列研究中，在调整年均空气污染物暴露后，较多的NO2超标天数与随后更快的认知下降相关。这表明，即使被其他日子的较低暴露所抵消，每日暴露于高NO2浓度也可能与加速认知衰老相关，这可能为识别和优先关注反复出现高NO2暴露的地区及促成其的本地排放源提供新的依据。

papers.title: When Is Maltreatment 'Acceptable'? Cross-Cultural Patterns in Child Maltreatment Exposure and its Perceived Social Acceptability Across 13 Countries and Regions
papers.translated_title: 虐待何时被视为“可接受”？13个国家和地区儿童虐待暴露及其社会可接受性认知的跨文化模式
papers.author: Jenkins, D.
papers.summary: Child maltreatment (CM) is a global phenomenon, yet its prevalence, acceptability, and psychosocial consequences vary across cultures. This study examined self-reported CM, its perceived acceptability, and associations with psychosocial outcomes among 1,617 adults (Mage = 25.21, SD = 6.74) across 13 countries and regions. Participants completed an online survey assessing physical neglect, physical abuse, emotional maltreatment, sexual abuse, and witnessing domestic violence, alongside perceived acceptability, post-traumatic growth, resilience, perceived social support, post-traumatic symptoms, and psychological distress. Country/region differences were tested via mixed-effects; whether CM-outcome associations varied by country/region was tested via fixed-effects interaction models. Significant cross-country/region variability emerged for most CM subtypes, especially for emotional maltreatment. Witnessing domestic violence rates did not differ significantly, though its acceptability still varied significantly, as did all other types. Greater CM exposure was linked to poorer mental health for several subtypes and to greater acceptability of maltreatment, raising concerns about intergenerational normalisation. CM-outcome associations were largely consistent across countries/regions, with only isolated, exploratory exceptions. Findings show that while CM's adverse psychosocial impact shows little cross-national variation, its prevalence and normative framing are culturally shaped, underscoring the need for culturally sensitive assessment and intervention.
papers.translated_summary: 儿童虐待（CM）是一个全球性现象，但其流行率、可接受度及心理社会后果因文化而异。本研究考察了来自13个国家和地区的1，617名成年人（平均年龄=25.21，标准差=6.74）自我报告的儿童虐待、其感知可接受度以及与心理社会结果的关联。参与者完成了一项在线调查，评估身体忽视、身体虐待、情感虐待、性虐待和目睹家庭暴力，以及感知可接受度、创伤后成长、心理韧性、感知社会支持、创伤后症状和心理困扰。国家和地区的差异通过混合效应模型检验；儿童虐待与结果的关联是否因国家和地区而异通过固定效应交互模型检验。大多数儿童虐待亚型在跨国/地区间存在显著变异，尤其是情感虐待。目睹家庭暴力的发生率没有显著差异，但其可接受度仍存在显著差异，其他所有类型也是如此。较高的儿童虐待暴露与若干亚型中较差的心理健康状况以及更高的虐待可接受度相关，引发了对代际正常化的担忧。儿童虐待与结果的关联在各国家和地区间基本一致，仅有孤立的、探索性例外。研究结果表明，尽管儿童虐待的不良心理社会影响在跨国间差异不大，但其流行率和规范性框架受文化塑造，凸显了文化敏感评估和干预的必要性。

papers.title: A scoping review of the format, content, effectiveness and acceptability of reproductive life planning tools.
papers.translated_title: 生殖生活规划工具的形式、内容、有效性及可接受性的范围综述。
papers.author: Stewart, C. L.
papers.summary: Purpose Screening for pregnancy intention and discussing Reproductive Life Planning (RLP) helps people reflect on their reproductive goals and how to achieve them. This scoping review maps the evidence on these approaches to inform their development and implementation in the UK. Methods: We searched Medline, Embase, PsycINFO and Scopus, and Google for the grey literature. Data were extracted on audience, format, content, features, behaviour change theory, effectiveness and acceptability. Results: 51 published and 21 grey literature sources were included. 25 RLPs were discussed in the published papers and 20 in the grey literature. Most came from the USA, most RLPs in published papers were asked verbally, while most grey literature RLPs were self-completed, there were six digital RLPs. Most ask whether an individual wants children, some then ask about number and timing of children, and contraception. RLPs are acceptable to people of reproductive age and healthcare professionals, and there is a desire for digital tools. While there is consistency in the questions asked, there is limited data on effectiveness and only three tools incorporated behaviour change theory. Conclusion A digital tool that builds on the evidence and integrates appropriate theory could enable more people to realise their reproductive goals.
papers.translated_summary: 目的 筛查妊娠意愿并讨论生殖生活规划（Reproductive Life Planning, RLP）有助于人们反思其生殖目标以及如何实现这些目标。本范围综述梳理了这些方法的证据，以为其在英国的制定和实施提供参考。方法：我们检索了Medline、Embase、PsycINFO和Scopus，并在Google中检索灰色文献。提取的数据涉及受众、形式、内容、特征、行为改变理论、有效性和可接受性。结果：共纳入51篇已发表文献和21篇灰色文献来源。已发表论文中讨论了25种RLP，灰色文献中讨论了20种。大多数来自美国，已发表论文中的大多数RLP是口头询问，而灰色文献中的大多数RLP是自填式，其中有六种数字化RLP。大多数询问个体是否想要孩子，有些随后询问孩子数量和生育时间，以及避孕情况。RLP对育龄人群和医疗保健专业人员来说是可接受的，并且人们希望有数字化工具。尽管所询问的问题具有一致性，但关于有效性的数据有限，且只有三种工具纳入了行为改变理论。结论：一种基于证据并整合适当理论的数字化工具，可能使更多人能够实现其生殖目标。

papers.title: WHITE-Net : White matter HyperIntensities Tissue Extraction using deep learning Network
papers.translated_title: WHITE-Net：使用深度学习网络提取白质高信号组织
papers.author: Cathala, C.
papers.summary: White matter hyperintensities (WMH) are a hallmark of cerebral small vessel disease, a highly prevalent condition in aging, making their accurate detection in large-scale magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) studies critically important. Currently available semi-automated and automated segmentation methods are frequently limited by sensitivity to variations in imaging conditions and computational constraints, restricting their applicability across diverse acquisition settings. We present WHITE-Net, a deep learning-based framework for automated WMH segmentation built on a 3D ResUNet architecture and trained on multisite MRI data encompassing substantial variability in scanner vendors, acquisition protocols, spatial resolution, and image characteristics. Evaluated across three independent datasets - BrainLaus, ADNI, and WMH Challenge, WHITE-Net achieves high segmentation accuracy and ranks among the top-performing methods across datasets, enabling a comprehensive assessment of generalisability in varied imaging environments. WHITE-Net maintains stable performance in a wide spectrum of lesion loads and demonstrates a favorable balance between precision and recall, effectively limiting false positive detections - a common limitation of existing approaches. Beyond accuracy, WHITE-Net requires no parameter tuning and offers fast inference times, making it well-suited for deployment in large-scale neuroimaging studies. The obtained results highlight the value of training on diverse multisite data for improving generalisability and position WHITE-Net as a reliable, scalable tool for automated WMH segmentation in computational anatomy research.
papers.translated_summary: 白质高信号（WMH）是脑小血管病的标志性特征，这是一种在衰老过程中高度普遍的疾病，因此在大规模磁共振成像（MRI）研究中准确检测其至关重要。目前可用的半自动和自动分割方法常常受限于对成像条件变化的敏感性和计算约束，限制了它们在不同采集设置中的适用性。我们提出了WHITE-Net，这是一个基于深度学习的自动WMH分割框架，建立在3D ResUNet架构之上，并在涵盖扫描仪厂商、采集协议、空间分辨率和图像特征等方面存在显著差异的多中心MRI数据上进行训练。在三个独立数据集——BrainLaus、ADNI和WMH Challenge——上进行评估后，WHITE-Net实现了高分割精度，并在各数据集中位列表现最佳的方法之列，从而能够全面评估其在多样成像环境中的泛化能力。WHITE-Net在广泛的病灶负荷范围内保持稳定性能，并在精确率和召回率之间表现出有利的平衡，有效限制了假阳性检测——这是现有方法的一个常见局限。除准确性之外，WHITE-Net无需参数调优，并提供快速推理时间，使其非常适合部署在大规模神经影像研究中。所获得的结果凸显了在多样多中心数据上训练对于提升泛化能力的价值，并将WHITE-Net定位为计算解剖学研究中用于自动WMH分割的可靠、可扩展工具。

papers.title: Seeded Probes Do Not Identify a Reviewer's Miss Rate: One-Sided Misclassification in Distribution-Free Risk Control
papers.translated_title: 种子探针无法识别审稿人的漏检率：无分布风险控制中的单侧误分类
papers.author: Kotabhattara, K. C.
papers.summary: Distribution-free risk control certifies that the rate of defects that would change clinical management, among the answers an AI system releases, stays below a stated level, calibrated on cases a human reviewer has checked. The reviewer is an imperfect reference standard whose errors run one way: a missed defect enters calibration as a safe label. This one-sided misclassification lowers the risk on record at every release threshold, so the certificate is anti-conservative by a factor set by the reviewer's miss rate on the system's own defects. We show that seeded probes, which plant known defects and count the catches, do not identify this miss rate. A reviewer's chance of missing a defect depends on how hard that defect is to spot, its detectability. A probe samples defects at detectabilities its designer chose. The system's own defects fall at detectabilities nothing chose, and converting the probe's miss rate into theirs requires the very rate being sought. This holds whenever detectability is not fully captured by an observed score, since a score that captured it would let probes covering its range identify the rate. Cytology field validation builds probe sets whose miss rate is a floor on the true one. Even then the probe bounds the rate from below only, so it can reject a certificate and cannot grant one. The finite-sample label-noise corrections assume noise independent of the case given its label, but a reviewer misses the defects that read as plausible, and the condition they need fails in all four simulated reviewer profiles we examine. Testing that condition on an independent sample takes 185 adjudicated cases for a reviewer missing 85% of defects and 147,938 for one missing 3%. A second reader who adjudicates the cases the careful reviewer passed finds a miss with 95% confidence within 498, so looking for the noise directly costs far less than testing a model of it. Across the 17 physicians who graded at least twenty peer-confirmed defects in a public corpus of model answers, the share they passed varies more than sampling noise explains, with 63% of the variation real and the middle of the true rates spanning 7.5% to 47.9%, too wide to borrow one reviewer's rate for another.
papers.translated_summary: 无分布风险控制证明，在AI系统发布的答案中，会改变临床管理的缺陷率保持在规定水平以下，该校准基于人工审核者已检查的病例。审核者是一个不完美的参考标准，其错误单向发生：被漏掉的缺陷在校准中作为安全标签进入。这种单侧误分类降低了每个发布阈值上的记录风险，因此证书以审核者对该系统自身缺陷的漏检率所设定的因子呈反保守倾向。我们表明，种子探针——即植入已知缺陷并统计捕获数量——无法识别这一漏检率。审核者漏掉一个缺陷的概率取决于该缺陷有多难被发现，即其可检测性。探针以其设计者选定的可检测性对缺陷进行采样。系统自身的缺陷落在无人选择的检测性上，而将探针的漏检率转换为它们的漏检率，需要正是所寻求的那个率。只要可检测性未被观测分数完全捕捉，这一点就成立，因为若一个分数捕捉了它，覆盖其范围的探针就能识别该率。细胞学现场验证构建的探针集，其漏检率是真实漏检率的下限。即便如此，探针仅从下方界定该率，因此它可以拒绝证书，却不能授予证书。有限样本标签噪声校正假设噪声在给定病例标签的条件下独立，但审核者会漏掉那些读起来似乎合理的缺陷，而它们所需的条件在我们考察的全部四个模拟审核者画像中都不成立。在独立样本上检验该条件，对于漏掉85%缺陷的审核者需要185个裁定病例，对于漏掉3%的审核者需要147,938个。第二位读者对那位仔细审核者通过的病例进行裁定，在498个病例内即以95%置信度发现一个漏检，因此直接寻找噪声的成本远低于检验其模型。在一个公开的模型答案语料库中，17位至少评阅了20个经同行确认缺陷的医生，他们放行的比例变化超出抽样噪声所能解释的范围，其中63%的变异是真实的，而真实率的中部跨度从7.5%到47.9%，过宽而无法将一位审核者的率借用于另一位。
